title: Circuit-Diff: Factual Edit-based Intervention Method for Localizing Knowledge in Attribution Graphs
abstract: arXiv:2609.23892v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Mechanistic interpretability defines features as the fundamental units of a neural network and circuits as the weighted subgraphs that carry out its computation. Because individual neurons are polysemantic, Cross-Layer Transcoders (CLTs) were introduced as a way to approximate a model's circuits by generating an attribution graph. The nodes of that graph, however, are unlabeled features: reading a graph means pruning it and then working out by hand what each surviving node means. To make CLTs easier to use for circuit discovery, we introduce Circuit-Diff, which intervenes on the model itself with a low-rank factual edit and takes the features whose role in the attribution graph changes under that edit as related to the edited knowledge. translated_title: Circuit-Diff：一种基于事实编辑的干预方法，用于在归因图中定位知识
translated_abstract: 机制可解释性将特征定义为神经网络的基本单元，将电路定义为执行其计算的加权子图。由于单个神经元具有多义性，跨层转码器被引入作为一种通过生成归因图来近似模型电路的方法。然而，该图的节点是未标注的特征：阅读一张归因图意味着先对其进行剪枝，然后手动弄清楚每个保留节点的含义。为了让CLT更易于用于电路发现，我们提出了Circuit-Diff，该方法通过对模型本身施加低秩事实编辑来进行干预，并将在该编辑下其在归因图中角色发生变化的特征视为与被编辑知识相关的特征。在我们所检验的编辑中，被标记的节点不仅仅是对象词元的检测器：从CLT发布的特征仪表板中读取，它们包含了与历史、地理以及关联相关的特征……
tldr: 提出Circuit-Diff方法，通过对模型施加低秩事实编辑并检测归因图中特征角色的变化，自动定位与被编辑知识相关的电路节点，从而免去人工解读归因图的繁琐过程。
en_tdlr: Circuit-Diff localizes knowledge in attribution graphs by applying low-rank factual edits to the model and identifying features whose roles change under the edit, automating circuit discovery without manual graph reading.
